TOOLING BURST T4t — T4t — G3 instant bolt / chain (Lightning Blast, Zeus chain) (Run C-5, E3; architecture 03- § 2.2 grammars, § 2.3 alphabet; specs are conductor-authored with VERIFY flags — implement the spec as written and report any field that the primitives or the runtime cannot honour). task_id "T4t".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4a, T4b, T4f, T4h (all clauses), T4p, T4q, T4r and the new row "T4t — G3 instant bolt / chain (Lightning Blast, Zeus chain)" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. runs/C-5/specs/lightning_blast.json + runs/C-5/specs/zeus_chain.json (the specs — LAW: the renderer never selects targets or infers grammar from a name), export/effect_kit.py, export/godot_import.py (G1 component, pieces phase, screen_px, key states, T4r's burst_v1r + decal), export/vfx_material.gdshader, oracle/peak_pieces.py (run only), the primitives (512 working copies, four-plane greyscale RGBA unless noted): VF-prim-lightning-link-01/lightning_link_01_512.png (tileable end to end), VF-prim-lightning-branch-01/lightning_branch_01_512.png, VF-prim-lightning-prong-01/lightning_prong_01_512.png, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_bolt_e1_B/kit.json and ice_bolt_e2/kit.json (templates), tests/test_effect_kit.py, tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py (extend only).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

BUILD the G3 grammar as a runtime component `scenes/vfx/g3_bolt_chain.tscn` + script: (1) TARGET — target-tracking aim: the first target is the nearest eligible actor within range_px in a 60° cone along facing (T4f eligibility), else the range point along facing (a miss); (2) BOLT — instant: a jittered polyline from the release socket to the target (segment length ≈ 0.8 × link length; jitter ±12 px perpendicular; re-seeded per cast), rendered as N chain-link sprites (P05) placed end to end along the polyline (each link stretched ≤ 15 % to fit; the link's tileable ends meet), with at most one branch junction sprite per bolt at a random interior vertex (Lightning Blast: up to 2 branches; Zeus dialect: width ×1.35, one branch max, jewel-white core = palette band 3 pushed to (1.0,1.0,0.98)), and needle prongs at the target end (4 for Blast, 2 per hop for Zeus) — all on the T4a material, ADD blend for the bolt body, MIX-black dark duplicate OFF; bolt life = spec (0.12 s / 0.10 s per link set) then an afterimage by dissolve (0.15 s, band 3 first); (3) CHAIN — after hop_delay (Blast: 0.05 s ×1; Zeus: the spec's irregular list of 4, CV ≥ 0.25 asserted), the next target = nearest unhit eligible within hop_range_px of the last target (events decide; never a name), a new bolt from the last target's centre; (4) per-hop strike flash + victim tint + hit-stop (T4b) + contact label (T4f); (5) kits `lightning_blast_e3` and `zeus_chain_e3` registered (screen_px).
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/T4t/acceptance.json): headless trace with three dummies in a row: Blast hits the first and chains once; Zeus hits 4 in event order with the spec's delays (report the intervals and CV); link count per bolt and the ≤ 15 % stretch bound; no link overlaps by more than 4 px; prongs at the target; afterimage ends by 0.27 s; both kits validate; previously registered kits byte-identical; in-sandbox suite reds named.
Tests (unittest, stdlib): kit validation; the emitted scenes contain the named nodes; headless clock traces per the ACCEPTANCE; all previously registered kits export byte-identically; headless import exit 0.
DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/ (run only), export/replay.py, any test file except the three named (extend only), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4t/, the new kit directories named above and their registration lines in kits_v9.json. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under runs/C-5/t3/T4t/. Write out/files.json listing every file you changed with sha256.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4t"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
